choice_rows_scope.meaning: Only fresh greedy decisions where removing the residual changes the locally top-ranked source are included. All-choice counts, per-seed metrics, context ranges, and witnesses remain summarized; the full raw choice trace is retained in the immutable formal archive and is regenerated by the analyzer.

interpretation_limits: Recorded-perception rank counterfactuals remove the residual from current recorded scores only; they do not resimulate decisions or world outcomes.
Rule-based contrasts also change epsilon exploration and downstream RNG consumption, so they compare complete policies.
Per-source residuals pool outcomes across amount, route, body, competition, and time contexts; reported context variation is descriptive and does not prove harmful aliasing.
Eight fixed seeds in one 5x5 fixture do not establish general efficacy, lifetime benefit, or ecological fitness.

provenance.analysis: read-only Python stream over each seed record; no simulation/World construction
